> **Security vulnerabilities — do NOT use this template.**
> Follow the private disclosure process in
> [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) and email `contact@identuum.ai`.

> **Tier boundary reminder.** `identuum-idp-oss` is the Starter-tier
> core. Features that belong in Professional or Enterprise
> tiers (PAR, OIDC federation, audit log, reports, webhooks, MCP server,
> LDAP, SCIM, SPIFFE, dynamic vault, anomaly detection, advanced DCR,
> etc.) live in the separate commercial `identuum-idp-ce` module and
> should not be requested here.

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who is affected and how?

## Proposed solution

A clear, concise description of what you want to happen, and how it
fits into the existing Starter-tier surface.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why did you reject them?

## Compatibility

- Does this change the OAuth 2.1 / OIDC discovery surface?
- Does this require a new migration?
- Does this affect import boundaries (OSS → CE is forbidden)?

## Additional context

Links to specs (RFC numbers, OIDC spec sections), related issues,
prior art, etc.
